source.author: cic
source.text: magnum opus omnino et arduum, Brute, conamur; sed nihil difficile amanti puto.
source.text_original: magnum opus omnino et arduum, Brute, conamur; sed nihil difficile amanti puto.
source.text_english: We are attempting a great and very difficult task, Brutus; but I think nothing is hard for one who loves.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Nihil amantibus durum est, nullus difficilis cupienti labor.
reuse.text_original: Nihil amantibus durum est, nullus difficilis cupienti labor.
reuse.text_english: Nothing is hard for those who love; no toil is difficult for one who desires.
